description.en: An original small bivalved arthropod for an imaginative prehistoric world. Static artistic interpretation inspired by Waptia fieldensis, with separated appendages and a quietly curved ringed abdomen.
description.zh: 为奇想史前世界创作的小型双瓣甲节肢动物。以瓦普塔虾为灵感的静态艺术化演绎，附肢清晰分离，环节腹部轻轻弯曲。

scientific_scope.en: An original stylized scene prop for an imaginative prehistoric world. Colors, pose, simplified details and scale are artistic choices. Static and unrigged. A mixed-period collection does not imply that these organisms lived together.
scientific_scope.zh: 面向想象史前世界的原创风格化场景配角。色彩、姿态、简化细节与比例为艺术选择；静态、无绑定。跨时代组合不表示这些生物真实共存。
